emily (People Ops): Idea: run a Coffee Cart pop-up that hands out $10 coffee cards + sticker for recent spot-award recipients. Low-friction, quick delight. Need logistics and tax clarity.

noah (Facilities): I can get the mobile cart on-site Wed lunchtime. Need delivery window for cards and stickers Mon morning.

zoe (Design): I can make a tiny sleeve for the card that says "Thanks for going above and beyond". Will post art in #people-ops-assets.

omar (Payroll): FYI: $10 cards are non-taxable for employees under our policy, but we should track counts. Contractors: gift cards okay if under $100 cumulative; otherwise we need vendor routing.

riley (Recruiting): Recruiting can staff one shift and help identify any recent hires who should be included.

people-bot: Export shows 62 eligible recipients in the last 60 days. 8 are contractors; 5 remote. Link: https://go.example.com/coffee-cart-export

emily (People Ops): Plan: onsite pop-up Wed 12:00-13:30, cart in Lobby B. Remote recipients get mailed card + sticker. Budget estimate: $12 per onsite (incl cart tip) and $7 shipping for remote.

noah (Facilities): Security asks for a one-pager describing activities and photo policy. Also confirm power access.

zoe (Design): Uploaded sleeve mock and sticker sheet. Teal sleeve + white type. Printing 100 sleeves by Tue.

omar (Payroll): Please provide final recipient list before distribution for audit. I'll provide GL code after that.

emily (People Ops): Action items: 1) Noah reserve Lobby B + deliverables (by Mon). 2) Zoe finalize prints (by Tue). 3) People Ops to mask addresses for volunteers and mail remote packs (by Tue). 4) Omar to confirm GL code (by Tue EOD). 5) Riley to post volunteer shifts.

riley (Recruiting): Signed up 12:00-12:45 shift. Bringing phone for quick consent checkbox on sign-in.

emily (People Ops): Consent: quick opt-in tick that allows us to post a group photo in #general. Otherwise no photos. Keep it simple.

people-bot: Reminder set: finalize_list -> 2026-04-20T10:00:00-07:00
